title: Keep a vanished frozen test-run declaration across later rereads
outcome: When a run's frozen completion.request.json was read and later disappears, the host index keeps showing the declaration it gave on every later reread of the run, never request.json's possibly rewritten one. Today the vanished-copy branch keeps the previous declaration but records stamp None, so the next reread (e.g. after results.json changes) no longer knows a frozen copy was read and adopts request.json's declaration. Keep the provenance "a frozen declaration was read" separately from the file's current stamp, and extend the regression test to change results.json and rescan after the disappearance.
acceptance: After a frozen completion.request.json has been read and then removed, every later rescan of the run, including after results.json changes, shows the frozen declaration (or none, when the frozen copy declared none), never request.json's. A test removes the frozen copy, changes results.json, rescans, and shows this.
